title: drosera indica var. makinoi
intro: Drosera indica var. makinoi, commonly known as Japanese Sundew, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the Droseraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Drosera indica var. makinoi are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit analgesic and anti-spasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties are primarily triterpenoid saponins and flavonoids, although further research is necessary to confirm the exact mechanisms of action.
